relations.title: The Limits of AI Oversight
relations.reading: Trust supports collaboration, but timely review still depends on explicit decision context and actual response capacity.

relations.title: Optimization, Coherence, and the Frame
relations.reading: Functional trust can support early disclosure of uncertainty when protecting the mission requires giving up a locally favourable account of progress.

relations.title: Architectural Entropy: How Mediated Systems Spend Human “Exergy” and the Partial Irreversibility of Human Intelligence Debt
relations.reading: An intense intervention should end with recovery and transfer conditions that preserve the team's capability rather than treating sustained overload as proof of commitment.

relations.title: UC-EA-03 — Architecture-Validation Profile — Human Oversight under Bounded Effective Capacity and Non-curative Approval — v0.4 — Maintenance Freeze
relations.reading: Human accountability requires effective intervention capacity as well as authority; a nominal approval does not repair an unsupported or time-expired decision.
